description: The line plot titled “Hidden State Mean” illustrates the mean absolute values of hidden states across different layers, comparing values before and after gating, as well as against a baseline. The x-axis is labeled “Layer” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 24, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled “Abs Mean” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5, with tick labels appearing at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line represents the “hidden state mean before gate,” starting at approximately 0.05 in layer 0 and increasing steadily to reach approximately 4.5 in layer 24. The orange dotted line represents the “hidden state mean after gate,” starting at approximately 0.05 in layer 0 and remaining relatively flat across layers, with a slight decline after layer 15 to approximately 0.03 by layer 24. The green solid line represents the “hidden state mean of baseline,” starting at approximately 0.02 in layer 0 and increasing slightly to approximately 0.05 by layer 24, remaining consistently below the post-gating values across all layers. The legend in the top left provides a clear description of the three lines.
